gates.name: Project definition and kill criteria
gates.question: Is the project defined precisely enough to evaluate sites?

gates.name: Regional and utility-territory feasibility
gates.question: Which markets and utility regimes deserve attention?

gates.name: Parcel desktop fatal-flaw screen
gates.question: Does a parcel survive ownership, buildability, infrastructure and hazard screening?

gates.name: Human validation and ground truth
gates.question: Do utilities, governments, providers and the physical site support the desktop theory?

gates.name: Site control and diligence rights
gates.question: Can the customer control land conditionally while diligence proceeds?

gates.name: Utility and power path
gates.question: Is there a credible path to the required quantity, quality, price, reliability and date of power?

gates.name: Physical, environmental and resource feasibility
gates.question: Can the facility actually be built and operated?

gates.name: Entitlement and political durability
gates.question: Can approvals be obtained and survive politics, appeals and community opposition?

gates.name: Integrated business case
gates.question: Does the combined site still make financial sense?

gates.name: Transferable evidence and commercial readiness
gates.question: Can a buyer, lender or investment committee independently audit and reuse the work?

gates.name: Closing, construction, energization and lifecycle
gates.question: Can the project execute through construction and operation?
